objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Current version number of the document, incremented upon revision.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable duration (default 3 years) after which the document must be reviewed for validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable duration (default 10 years) for which an archived document is retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or area of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References to other documents or master data linked to this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications referenced or linked to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity assigned to the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content, supporting multi-language versions.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document, released together with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment, maintained independently.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release process of the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changes to an existing released document, managed separately without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend validity, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a document that has no additional validity, triggering archiving of the document and its attachments.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated (archived) document, restoring its metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person in the system who can hold various roles and participates in document lifecycle activities.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users that can be assigned authorizations and distribution responsibilities for documents.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of workflow steps such as creation, review, and release.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document that controls read authorization and notification upon release.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity in the system to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process in the system to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object in the system to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference data (e.g. IT applications) that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific user interface listing documents and evaluations relevant to a user based on distribution group assignments.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process controlling the sequence of steps (creation, review, release) for document approval and other lifecycle activities.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document (information object) is created in the system by selecting a document type and optionally a template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of document being created.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: A workflow participant completes a workflow step by providing an electronic signature.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for distribution to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when changes are made to content, attachments, or via change proposals.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled document) is added to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the change proposal; the creator receives notification and it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (or author, reviewer, releaser together) confirms the document's additional validity, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document, starting the override workflow automatically.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group, and the archive duration begins.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A business admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, restoring a new version with previous metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are informed by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of the released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language and submitted for checking and release.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version of a document is reviewed, approved, and released, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read and write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

A distribution list is maintained per document for controlling notification and read access.
A distribution list contains assigned user groups.
A distribution list contains directly assigned persons.
A user can be assigned to one or more user groups.
